# Catalogue of aggregate tables {#sec-table-catalogue}

```{r}
source("R/book.R")
```

The aggregate tables are in five folders. These lists are generated from the
index file (`README_outputs.csv`) that the pipeline writes into each folder,
except the registration tables, which are listed by hand.
An asterisk in a file name stands for several files: `set2_static_by_*.csv`
is one file for each characteristic. @sec-aggregate-tables explains how to
use them.

## Mileage tables: `tables/mileage/`

Details: [Vehicles and mileage by postcode area](../reports/mileage_report.md).

```{r}
m <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "mileage", "README_outputs.csv")
m$file <- paste0("`", m$file, "`")
kable(m, col.names = c("File", "One row per", "Contents"))
```

## Fleet profile tables: `tables/profile/`

Details: [Fleet profile tables](../reports/fleet_profile_report.md).

```{r}
p <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "profile", "README_outputs.csv")
p$file <- paste0("`", p$file, "`")
kable(p, col.names = c("File", "Form", "Contents"))
```

## Registration tables: `tables/registration/`

Details: [Does the MOT data hold every registered vehicle?](../reports/registration_report.md).

| File | One row per | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `registration_by_age.csv` | year, body type, age (0 to 40; 40 includes older) | CARS located and MOT stock; DfT licensed and SORN (VEH0124) |
| `registration_by_fuel_engine.csv` | year, body type, fuel group, engine size band | The same counts, with DfT's from VEH0220 |
| `registration_by_pca.csv` | year, postcode area, body group, and fuel group or age band | CARS located and MOT stock |
| `registration_cohorts.csv` | body type, year of first use | Vehicles, how many were ever located, the DVLA tax status of those never located, and DfT's count of the cohort at ages 0, 1 and 4 |
| `registration_tax_status.csv` | body type, MOT history, DVLA tax status, DVLA MOT status, age in the last year | Vehicles |
| `registration_never_located.csv` | body type and one of make, engine band, fuel, test class or tax status | Vehicles first used in the settled cohort years, and how many were ever located |

## Car size and model tables: `tables/racf/`

Details: [The RACF / SMMT car fleet, linked to the MOT data](../reports/racf_linked_report.md).

```{r}
r <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "racf", "README_outputs.csv")
r$file <- paste0("`", r$file, "`")
kable(r, col.names = c("File", "Group", "Contents"))
```
